about_short_description.short_description: One Stop Fintech Software for Banks & NBFCs. Loan Origination System, Loan Management System, Accounting System, Customer Journeys & more

product.name: Loan Origination System (LOS)
product.description: A system that manages the end-to-end process of loan application, verification, approval, and disbursement for banks and NBFCs.

product.name: Loan Management System (LMS)
product.description: A system that manages loan servicing, repayment tracking, collections, and customer account management for banks and NBFCs.

product.name: Accounting System
product.description: A software system that handles financial accounting, banking reconciliation, and transaction management for banks and NBFCs.

product.name: Collection System
product.description: A system designed to manage loan repayment collections, track overdue payments, and support recovery processes for financial institutions.

product.name: Customer Portal
product.description: A self-service portal that allows customers to access loan information, update KYC details, make payments, and raise grievances.
